info.name: CromCull
info.summary: Find and manage byte-identical duplicate files
info.description:
CromCull finds byte-identical duplicate files across your Nextcloud storage and lets you decide what to do about them.
**How it works:** - Size-bucket pre-filter using Nextcloud's existing file cache (no re-scanning) - Partial hash (first 64KB, SHA-256) to cheaply eliminate non-matches - Full-file SHA-256 to confirm exact duplicates - Persistent hash cache uses Nextcloud's edit tracking to skip re-hashing unchanged files — repeat scans are significantly faster, especially on external storage - The first scan reads and hashes every file (a good overnight task for large libraries); after that, the cache keeps things fast
**Safety first:** - CromCull never deletes anything automatically - Every deletion is an explicit, per-file human decision - All deletions go through Nextcloud's own trash bin, protected by live re-verification before every delete - Group folders and shared files are blocked from deletion - A permanent CSV audit log records every action
**Features:** - Chunked scanning with progress bar and cancel support - Per-group Recheck button to re-verify a single group without a full rescan - Hide/Un-Hide duplicate groups per-user, keyed on content hash so future copies are automatically hidden - Configurable size filters and extension ignore lists - Folder exclusions via marker files that travel with renamed/moved folders - Review UI with per-file external links for side-by-side comparison - Batch delete across multiple groups with confirmation modal - Admin hash cache management panel with entry count and full cache clear - `cromcull:status` occ command for CLI visibility into scan state and cache stats
info.author: Scott Skaife
